Done. The change is complete and the test suite is green.

## What I changed

**One file, one function** — `AssignCustomerCode.service`:

The `customerCode` now builds as `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`:
- `CITY3` — upper-cased first three letters of the city
- `LAST3` — upper-cased first three letters of the last name
- `NNNN` — a per-city 4-digit sequence, one more than the owners already in that city (filtered from `findAll()`, case-insensitively by city)

I extracted a tiny private `prefix(...)` helper so the two three-letter prefixes reuse the same logic rather than growing the method.

## Why nothing else needed touching

The membership number is derived, not stored — `OwnerMapper` computes it as `owner.getCustomerCode() + "-M" + ...`. Because it reads `getCustomerCode()` at mapping time, it automatically rebuilds on the new format the moment `customerCode` changes. No mapper, model, or repository edit was required, keeping the structural impact to a single small, low-complexity function in one file.

Full suite: `BUILD SUCCESS`, all tests pass (including the new `coreCustomerCodeHasCityPrefix`, which asserts the `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}` shape).
